description: This file defines the StreamSubscriptionManager class, which manages stream subscriptions in the Orleans streaming framework. It includes methods to add, remove, and retrieve subscriptions, interacting with a pub/sub system.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Manages stream subscriptions including adding, removing, and querying subscriptions.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Creates and registers a new stream subscription for a grain, returning the subscription details.

methods.name: RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Unregisters a stream subscription given the provider name, stream ID, and subscription ID.

methods.name: GetSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specific stream, returning an enumerable of StreamSubscription objects.
